sources.title: James Jones: I'm on text threads with former Packers, none are on Aaron Rodgers' side
sources.description: In the dispute between Steelers coach Mike McCarthy and ex-Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers, players who were with both of them in Green Bay are squarely on McCarthy's side.
